name: parseSimplePositiveInteger
input: Input buffer containing '123' at current pointer, in non-root context
expected: Returns JsonToken.VALUE_NUMBER_INT because the number has no fractional or exponential part.

name: parseNegativeIntegerWithRootSpaceVerification
input: Input buffer containing '-456 ' in root parsing context (_parsingContext.inRoot() == true)
expected: Returns JsonToken.VALUE_NUMBER_INT after successfully verifying the required root spacing via _verifyRootSpace.

name: parseNumberDelegatesToParserNumber2OnBufferBoundary
input: Input buffer where integer reading hits _inputEnd requiring continuation in _parserNumber2
expected: Delegates to _parserNumber2 to correctly parse the remaining digits across buffer boundaries or segment limits.

name: parseNumberDelegatesToParseFloatOnDecimal
expected: Encounters '.' and delegates to _parseFloat to parse fractional parts.

name: parseNumberDelegatesToParseFloatOnExponent
expected: Encounters 'e' or 'E' and delegates to _parseFloat to parse exponent parts.

name: parseInvalidNumberStartAfterMinus
input: Input buffer containing '-' followed by non-digit char (e.g., '-a')
expected: Calls _handleInvalidNumberStart because a minus sign must be followed by a digit.

name: parserNumber2ReachesEOFSuccessfully
input: Input buffer runs out of content while parsing digits in _parserNumber2 without further tokens
expected: Finishes reading and returns resetInt(negative, intPartLength) when no more input can be loaded.

name: parserNumber2EncountersDecimalOrExponent
expected: Switches execution to _parseFloat with the collected buffer segments and lengths.

name: parseFloatValidDecimalAndExponent
expected: Parses fraction length and exponent length successfully and returns resetFloat.

name: parseFloatMissingDigitAfterDecimal
input: Input buffer containing '123.' followed by non-digit or EOF
expected: Throws exception via reportUnexpectedNumberChar because decimal point is not followed by a digit.

name: parseFloatMissingDigitAfterExponent
input: Input buffer containing '123e' followed by non-digit or EOF
expected: Throws exception via reportUnexpectedNumberChar because exponent indicator is not followed by a digit.

name: verifyRootSpaceWithSpaceOrTab
expected: Advances _inputPtr past the space character successfully without throwing.

name: verifyRootSpaceWithCarriageReturn
expected: Invokes _skipCR() to handle line endings correctly and advances row counts.

name: verifyRootSpaceWithLineFeed
expected: Increments row count (_currInputRow) and updates row start pointer (_currInputRowStart).

name: verifyRootSpaceInvalidCharacterThrowsException
input: Root space character is an alphanumeric or invalid separator (e.g. 'a')
expected: Throws exception via _reportMissingRootWS(ch) because root values must be separated by whitespace.

name: skipWSOrEndSkipsWhitespaceAndComments
input: Input buffer containing spaces, tabs, newlines, and comments '/' or '#'
expected: Successfully skips all whitespace and comments according to enabled features, returning the next non-whitespace token byte or -1 on EOF.

name: skipWSOrEndReportsInvalidChar
input: Input buffer containing illegal control or invalid UTF-8 start characters during whitespace skipping
expected: Calls _reportInvalidChar(i) due to default case mapping in the whitespace/syntax lookup table.
